securityProperties: Private-beta endpoints are unavailable while the production flag is false.
Access-code verification is server-side, exact after trim, case-sensitive, and constant-time.
Pending tokens are one-use and expire after 15 minutes.
Completed access is user-bound and expires absolutely after 12 hours.
Durable failed-attempt limits are five per browser flow and twenty per network per 15 minutes.
Only keyed network and flow hashes are stored.
PUBLIC, anon, and authenticated have no direct access to private-beta tables or functions.
Founder and longer existing beta entitlements are not shortened.
Supabase PKCE session persistence uses sessionStorage.
Private-beta pending/access tokens and browser flow state use sessionStorage only.
All authenticated browser Worker callers forward the opaque admission token.

resolvedLaunchGates.evidence: Read-only production aggregates verified four distinct founder role rows linked one-to-one to existing Auth users and profiles; staging tests prove founders are preserved and ordinary admissions receive beta_tester without duplicate roles.
Owner-provided authorization is recorded without inventing an independent counsel opinion or approver identity.

resolvedLaunchGates.item: Live blind Gemini and Philippine legal-authority benchmark
resolvedLaunchGates.evidence: GitHub Actions run 30630062756 passed the frozen 24-sample, eight-subject benchmark with 32/32 provider requests, zero unsafe false-highs, and zero fabricated authorities.

Read-only production probes passed 62/62 requests through concurrency 16; Gemini passed 32/32 serialized requests and demonstrated HTTP 429 at concurrency two, establishing a conservative single-request grading lane.

decision: GO — proceed with the controlled production sequence while keeping admission closed until database, Worker, frontend, and rollback verification pass.
